§3§lPurpose§r
Use the Link Terminal for wireless EU, portable/device terminals and panels for monitoring, and the Quantum Terminal for ME connections. Factory Mode and the dashboard bring existing data together.

§3§lReading route§r
This chapter contains §122§r quests. The overview introduces the wheel and monitoring profiles as separate branches. The wheel leads to Factory Mode, regional audits and dashboard editing/sharing; profiles lead to multiplayer sharing and continuous sampling. Learn the monitor, device, panel and quantum item branches as needed, and configure sources before trying their views.

§3§lCommon entrances§r
Defaults are C for the wheel, H for the Portable Monitor viewer, F12 for Factory Mode and F10 for the dashboard; follow your bindings. Tick manual tutorials after understanding them, and complete crafting/item checks as stated. Keep relevant chunks loaded and supply AE power and channels. Lost-item recovery requires prior profile import.
